title: Developer Advocate - Remote
description:
About Us

At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data use.

For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 2,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.

About the role

You’re a natural bridge between technology and people—a communicator who thrives on making complex topics clear, exciting, and accessible. You have a genuine passion for empowering developers, backed by hands-on technical expertise and a curiosity that keeps you experimenting with new tools, frameworks, and ideas. You’re equally at home coding up a quick demo as you are standing on stage, streaming live, or publishing a deep-dive article. You believe in community as more than just a buzzword — it’s about fostering connections, listening with intent, and inspiring others to build.

As a Developer Advocate at Zyte, you’ll champion our web scraping and data extraction tools to developers around the world, shaping how they learn, adopt, and innovate with our technology. You’ll create projects, stories, and resources that highlight the power of Zyte API and Scrapy, connecting with our audience across events, social channels, and developer communities. You’ll work closely with product and marketing teams, bringing community insights back into our roadmap, while amplifying the voices of developers who use our tools. Your work will make a tangible impact—growing awareness, deepening trust, and helping Zyte define the Web Scraping API category

Responsibilities

  • Create content (written, video, webinars) and code samples that demonstrate how to work with and integrate Zyte tools.
  • Engage with the community across social channels and forums and showcase how to solve web scraping challenges
  • Educate, showcase and demo our products to our communities and beyond
  • Speak at developer-focused events
  • Write blog posts for Zyte and third-party sites.
  • Identify external advocates and community leaders, and support them as they talk about Zyte and web data extraction independent of us.
  • Represent the developer POV in the marketing team.
  • Work with our technical teams to identify content opportunities and channel community feedback
  • Identify opportunities to improve documentation and be an active contributor
  • Post regularly on the company’s social channels for our developer audience

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in developer advocacy, community engagement, or related technical roles
  • Strong understanding of web technologies, APIs, web scraping, and data extraction
  • Demonstrable knowledge of Python.
  • Interest in web data extraction
  • A passion for developers and helping developers.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with some experience with public speaking
  • Proven experience working with communities, social media, and blogging required.
  • A background in community building and event hosting is a plus
  • Self-motivated, self-reliant and able to prioritize tasks.
  • Strong team player

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Scrapy, headless browsers and web scraping is a plus but not a hard requirement.

As a new Zytan, you will

  • Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team.
  • Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work.
  • Attend conferences and meet with team members from across the globe.
  • Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools.
  • 35 days paid holidays

As the most widely used Linux distribution, Ubuntu underpins the security of the entire internet. The role of Security Engineering Manager directly impacts the safety and security of millions of users worldwide. Join a team of security experts dedicated to protecting the open-source ecosystem and driving innovation. Your leadership will be instrumental in addressing emerging threats, developing robust security measures, and ensuring the continued integrity of Ubuntu. This is an opportunity to make a tangible difference and leave a lasting legacy on the digital landscape.
As we place ever more trust in software and data security in our increasingly connected world, Canonical's mission to deliver the world's best open source platform comes with a responsibility: to set the highest possible standard for software security, not only for the OS, but also for the wide range of open source infrastructure and software that developers enjoy within the Ubuntu ecosystem. With Canonical's Ubuntu being the leading open source platform for large-scale cloud and edge deployments, we are increasingly called upon to help customers meet strict security requirements such as FIPS, CIS, STIG, FedRAMP and the new CRA.
This role is about leading the charge to set the security standards for open source software across the Ubuntu platform, from desktops, servers and edge devices to cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes and OpenStack, by certifying core components to meet industry standards and guiding development teams across the company in security best practices. We work primarily within the areas of cryptographic modules (FIPS 140) and system hardening, where we collaborate with industry partners including CIS and DISA to define and build secure operating system deployments.
An Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team and product from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role.
What you will do in this role

  • Lead and develop a team of engineers, ranging from graduate to senior
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Support our products and customers to meet strict product security requirements such as FIPS, CIS, STIG, FedRAMP and the new CRA
  • Support the work addressing specific cryptography modules (FIPS 140) and system hardening efforts with indrustry partners, including CIS and DISA
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

  • Drive, and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • A love of developing and growing people and a track record of it
  • Organised and able to ensure your team delivers timely, high quality results
  • Professional manner interacting with colleagues, partners, and community
  • Prior experience working on FIPS/Common Criteria certified products and in-depth knowledge of the underlying standards
  • Prior experience working directly with DISA-STIG or CIS benchmarks, including related audit + remediation tooling (e.g. Compliance as Code)
  • Knowledgeable and passionate about software and application security
  • Solid experience working in an agile development environment
  • A demonstrated drive for continual learning
  • Builds trust, relationships and confidence
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each
Optional things we value

Overview

O Ton é uma empresa do grupo Stone Co., focada em empoderar empreendedores autônomos por meio de soluções financeiras como maquininhas, conta digital, cartão e programa de renda extra. Nosso time é apaixonado por desafios e movido por impacto real na vida dos nossos clientes — sempre com leveza, autonomia e muita colaboração. Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

A equipe do programa Renda Extra | TON está dedicada a transformar vidas por meio de oportunidades únicas de geração de renda. Nosso programa oferece uma maneira inovadora para os nossos parceiros, de obter uma renda adicional ou até mesmo substituir sua fonte de renda principal sem nenhum vínculo empregatício. Nosso objetivo é empoderar as pessoas, proporcionando-lhes os meios para alcançar a estabilidade financeira e crescimento pessoal.

Você terá um papel essencial na evolução do nosso ecossistema, atuando no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, provas de conceito e melhorias contínuas nos nossos microsserviços e aplicações. Aqui, valorizamos opiniões, ideias novas e iniciativas — queremos que você protagonize melhorias e ajude a elevar a barra técnica do produto. title: Tester de Software (QA) / Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento - Trabalho Remoto
description:
Tester de Software (QA) / Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento - Trabalho Remoto

Há mais de 15 anos, a BairesDev é líder em projetos tecnológicos. Entregamos soluções inovadoras para gigantes como Google e Rolls-Royce e as startups mais inovadoras do Vale do Silício.

Temos uma equipe diversa de mais de 4.000 profissionais formada pelo Top 1% dos talentos de tecnologia do mundo, trabalhando remotamente em cargos de impacto global.

Ao se candidatar para este cargo, você está dando o primeiro passo em um processo que vai além do comum. Nosso objetivo é alinhar suas paixões, habilidades, e expectativas às nossas vagas, colocando você no caminho para desenvolver uma carreira de sucesso excepcional.

Tester de Software (QA) / Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento na BairesDev

Buscamos excelentes Tester de Software (QA) para se juntarem à equipe de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento (P&D) da BairesDev. Nossa equipe de P&D é uma parte essencial de nossas soluções de tecnologia que geram milhões em receita todos os anos, portanto, contratamos apenas os melhores entre os melhores.

Dentro da equipe, você encontrará muitos desafios diferentes: análise de dados, machine learning, desktop e desenvolvimentos da web são alguns dos mais relevantes no momento, mas você perceberá que coisas novas surgem todos os dias para impulsionar a inovação, A área de P&D é sem dúvida a área mais interessante e desafiadora de toda a empresa, e embora a BairesDev seja formada por pessoas realmente talentosas, aqui você encontrará profissionais com vasta experiência e também de nível intelectual e criativo, muito acima da média.

Queremos gente que curta o desafio! Você está pronto?

Responsabilidades

- Analisar os requisitos do usuário final para definir e documentar os planos de teste.

- Executar casos de teste, depurar, detectar erros e / ou possíveis melhorias, documentar e fazer o acompanhamento para serem resolvidos.

- Gerar relatórios de resultados de testes e dos erros detectados.

- Definir prioridades e planejar testes de requisitos de sistema.

- Documentar as funcionalidades dos sistemas.

- Representar o usuário final para os desenvolvedores para garantir que os requisitos sejam atendidos.

- Detectar e propor melhorias tanto no processo de controle de qualidade quanto no ciclo de desenvolvimento de software.

Esperamos que você tenha:

- 4+ anos de experiência em testes de Produtos Web.

- Sólidos conhecimentos em ferramentas de teste.

- Desenvolvimento de planos de teste: criação de casos de teste e depuração.

- Conhecimento adicional em tecnologias web.

- Amplo conhecimento em ambientes Unix e Linux.

- Nível avançado de inglês.

Como tornamos seu trabalho (e sua vida) mais fácil:

- Modalidade 100% remota - trabalhe de qualquer lugar.

- Excelente remuneração em USD ou na sua moeda local, como preferir.

- Hardware para você trabalhar de casa.

- Horários flexíveis - faça seu próprio horário.

- Licença parental remunerada, férias, e feriados nacionais.

- Ambiente de trabalho inovador e multicultural.

- Colabore e aprenda com o Top 1% global dos talentos de cada área.

- Ambiente de apoio com mentoria, promoções, desenvolvimento de habilidades, e diversas oportunidades de crescimento.

Junte-se a uma equipe global onde seus talentos excepcionais podem se destacar!

title: Chamada para seleção de propostas pesquisa científica: Desmatamento e sistemas alimentares no Brasil
description:
Chamada para seleção de propostas pesquisa científica: Desmatamento e sistemas alimentares no Brasil

Sobre a oportunidade

1. INTRODUÇÃO E CONTEXTO
A ProVeg Brasil é uma organização dedicada à transformação do sistema alimentar global, visando um futuro mais sustentável para todos, por meio do incentivo de dietas baseadas em vegetais. Reconhecemos a urgência e a complexidade dos desafios ambientais que o Brasil enfrenta, especialmente no que tange ao desmatamento e suas interconexões com os sistemas de produção e consumo de produtos de origem animal.
O Brasil assumiu o compromisso de alcançar o desmatamento zero até 2030, uma meta fundamental para a conservação de biomas de importância global, como a Amazônia e o Cerrado, e para o cumprimento de suas obrigações climáticas internacionais. Neste cenário, a agropecuária é amplamente reconhecida como um dos principais vetores de mudança no uso da terra no país.
Diante da relevância estratégica deste tema, a ProVeg Brasil busca subsidiar suas ações de advocacy e formulação de políticas públicas com evidências científicas robustas.
IMPORTANTE: ESTA NÃO É UMA VAGA DE EMPREGO. EM VEZ DE SE CANDIDATAR ATRAVÉS DO NOSSO SITE, ENVIE SUA PROPOSTA PARA , CONFORME EXPLICADO NA PARTE INFERIOR DESTA PÁGINA.

Detalhes da posição

2. OBJETIVO GERAL
Selecionar a elaboração de uma pesquisa científica para investigar a relação entre o desmatamento no Brasil e os sistemas de produção e consumo de produtos de origem animal, buscando compreender os desafios e as possibilidades para o alcance das metas de desmatamento zero no país.

Responsabilidades

3. ESCOPO DA PESQUISA / TEMAS DE INTERESSE
A pesquisa deverá abordar, de forma abrangente e crítica, os seguintes temas interligados:

  • Desmatamento e Pecuária: Análise da dinâmica e dos impactos da expansão da pecuária (bovina, suína, avícola e outras) e de monoculturas destinadas à alimentação animal sobre o desmatamento em biomas brasileiros, com especial atenção à Amazônia e ao Cerrado.
  • Cadeias de Suprimentos de Produtos de Origem Animal: Investigação do papel de todos os produtos de origem animal e de seus insumos (como a produção de grãos para ração animal, a exemplo da soja) na pressão sobre as florestas e vegetação nativa.
  • Avaliação de Soluções e Limitações: Exame aprofundado do alcance e das limitações de soluções propostas para a sustentabilidade da produção, como a pecuária regenerativa e a intensificação da produção, em relação às metas de desmatamento e à mitigação de emissões de gases de efeito estufa (incluindo o metano).
  • Padrões de Consumo e Produção: Análise dos níveis atuais de produção e consumo de produtos de origem animal no Brasil, considerando tanto o mercado interno quanto as exportações, e suas implicações para o cenário de desmatamento. O estudo deverá explorar cenários e quantificar as transformações necessárias para o alcance das metas de desmatamento zero.

Requisitos

4. RESULTADOS ESPERADOS / ENTREGAS
O trabalho contratado deverá resultar em:

  • Estudo Científico Detalhado: Um relatório de pesquisa completo, com metodologia clara, análise de dados e conclusões embasadas cientificamente. Espera-se que a versão final deste estudo tenha aproximadamente 25-30 páginas.
  • Policy Brief: Um documento conciso e direto, com recomendações estratégicas para guiar as ações de advocacy político da ProVeg Brasil junto a formuladores de políticas, setor privado e sociedade civil.

Benefícios de trabalhar conosco

Seleção e divulgação do resultado

13 a 27 de agosto

Assinatura de contrato e reunião de alinhamento

atividades elaborados pelo contratado(a)

Entrega final após revisão e aprovação

Mais informações

6. PÚBLICO-ALVO DA CHAMADA
Convidamos pessoas jurídicas (instituições de pesquisa, consultorias, universidades, etc.) com comprovada experiência e expertise nas áreas de desmatamento, sistemas alimentares, pecuária, sustentabilidade, economia ambiental e políticas públicas a submeterem suas propostas.

7. COLABORAÇÃO
A ProVeg Brasil está aberta a colaborar ativamente em todas as etapas do projeto, oferecendo suporte na elaboração do policy brief e na estratégia de divulgação dos resultados. A participação conjunta na publicização dos resultados será bem-vinda e poderá ser acordada.

8. INFORMAÇÕES PARA SUBMISSÃO
Para manifestar interesse no processo de seleção, por favor, entre em contato através do e-mail apresentando os seguintes documentos:

  • Carta de apresentação
  • CV ou Lattes
  • Proposta com valores

description:
Overview

Estamos em busca de um(a) Head Comercial para liderar, estruturar e potencializar o time de vendas da Elainne Ourives.

Há 10 anos, a Elainne Ourives vem impactando o Brasil com seus treinamentos, mentorias e formações únicas, sendo a maior autoridade do país no segmento de Cocriação e Frequência Vibracional. Com métodos exclusivos e patenteados, têm transformado a vida de milhares de pessoas, elevando sua consciência e frequência vibracional.

Você tem paixão por vendas, liderança e resultados? Quer atuar em uma empresa consolidada e que já transformou milhares de vidas? Então essa vaga é para você!

Como Head Comercial , seus principais desafios serão:

  • Liderar e motivar o time comercial
  • Analisar dados, KPIs e indicadores de performance
  • Estruturar processos e funis de vendas para lançamentos e produtos perpétuos
  • Atuar com agilidade em ciclos de lançamentos de 3 semanas
  • Gerenciar e analisar o CRM, monitorando o pipeline de vendas e identificando oportunidades de melhoria
  • Garantir agilidade no atendimento aos leads e acompanhar follow-ups realizados pela equipe
  • Desenvolver e liderar campanhas comerciais que elevem a performance do time
  • Monitorar métricas de desempenho individuais e coletivas, assegurando o cumprimento de metas
  • Conduzir reuniões regulares de alinhamento com a equipe e realizar encontros individuais para feedback
  • Implementar ferramentas e tecnologias que otimizem os resultados do setor comercial
  • Criar e atualizar materiais de apoio, como playbooks de vendas, para garantir a replicação de boas práticas
  • Analisar tendências do mercado e propor melhorias contínuas nos processos comerciais
  • Participar do recrutamento, seleção e treinamento de novos membros para fortalecer o time comercial
  • Desenvolver pessoas e promover um ambiente colaborativo e de alta performance

Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em vendas digitais e lançamentos de infoprodutos (imprescindível)
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de vendas (consultivas, SPIN Selling, etc.)
  • Experiência na liderança de times comerciais completos, incluindo a área de CS
  • Domínio em CRM, análise de dados, marketing digital e gestão de times
  • Perfil persuasivo, comunicativo e com forte orientação para resultados
  • Alinhamento aos valores da empresa

Buscamos Pessoas Inspiradoras Que

  • Tenham capacidade de engajar, motivar e desenvolver o time, transmitindo visão clara e entusiasmo
  • Pensem no crescimento do negócio e, ao mesmo tempo, coloquem a mão na massa quando necessário
  • Saibam lidar com pressão, manter equilíbrio diante de desafios e inspirar confiança
  • Tenham foco em metas e indicadores, sem perder a sensibilidade com as pessoas
  • Se ajustem às estratégias rapidamente em um ambiente dinâmico e inovador
  • Encarem obstáculos como oportunidades de crescimento
  • Transmita mensagens de forma transparente, conectando-se com diferentes perfis
  • Compreendam clientes, equipe e parceiros de forma genuína

Benefícios

  • Contratação PJ
  • Trabalho 100% remoto
  • Remuneração: fixo + comissão atrativa
  • Presente de aniversário
  • Encontro cultural anual na sede da empresa
  • Participação em todos os eventos presenciais da empresa
  • Treinamentos exclusivos e acesso completo aos cursos da Elainne Ourives
  • Desenvolvimento com imersão já paga com expert do digital de alto valor agregado
  • Ambiente de alta performance, com liberdade para cocriar, liderar e crescer com a empresa

Cultura e Valores

Nossa jornada é guiada pela Verdade, Amor, Responsabilidade, União, Segurança e Fé. Valorizamos alta performance, mentalidade de dono, aprendizado contínuo e colaboração real em equipe.

Aqui, Acreditamos Que Cultura é construída no dia a dia, com escolhas conscientes. Feedback é presente e parte da evolução. O extraordinário é sempre cocriação. Não buscamos apenas talento, buscamos pessoas alinhadas ao nosso propósito, que vivam aquilo que ensinamos. Candidate-se agora e venha cocriar o extraordinário com a gente.

title: Head of Sales - LATAM
description:
Who We Are

At MonetizeMore, we use AI and data to revolutionize how the advertising industry combats Invalid Traffic (IVT) and fraud. Our flagship product, Traffic Cop, is a premium solution designed to protect ad-monetized publishers and ad tech vendors from fraudulent activity. For over 15 years, our fully remote team of 100+ professionals has been driven by four core pillars: Integrity, Collaboration, Enterprising, and Kaizen. We are culture-centric, results-driven, and obsessed with building impactful, data-powered solutions.

What It’s Like Working Here

  • Actions > Talk: Execution is everything.
  • Slack & Async First: Clear, async communication is our lifeline.
  • Challenge Everything: “Why not?” is a welcome mindset.
  • Data > Ego: Bring your bold ideas—and the numbers to back them up.
  • No Titles, Just Results: Respect is earned, not granted.
  • Fail Fast, Learn Faster: Mistakes are data. We improve from them.
  • Follow Through: We do what we say—big or small.

Your Role: Head of Sales

As our Head of Sales, you’ll be responsible for defining, leading, and executing MonetizeMore’s global sales strategy. This is a high-impact leadership role for a strategic, hands-on sales expert who can build and scale a revenue engine across international markets, with a focus on high-value enterprise clients in the ad-tech space.

What You’ll Do

  • Own & Lead the Sales Function: Drive the entire sales cycle from strategy to execution—from lead generation to contract close.
  • Set the Sales Vision: Define and execute MonetizeMore’s go-to-market strategy in collaboration with the Executive Team.
  • Drive Strategic Revenue: Target and close deals with Publishers, have existing relationships, and understand needs of DSPs, SSPs, GCPPs, MCMs, and exchanges to drive partner-led sales for Traffic Cop across LATAM.
  • Build & Scale the Sales Team: Hire, coach, and manage high-performing sales talent, building a metrics-driven sales org.
  • Act as a Player-Coach: Stay hands-on in high-stakes sales conversations and negotiations while coaching others to success.
  • Present & Educate: Deliver compelling product pitches and demos tailored to client challenges and verticals.
  • Refine the Value Proposition: Work with Marketing and Product to sharpen our messaging and positioning in a competitive market.
  • Optimize Pipeline & Forecasting: Maintain an accurate sales pipeline, forecast revenue, and hit aggressive growth targets.
  • Establish Strategic Partnerships: Identify and onboard channel partners to amplify our reach and strengthen joint go-to-market efforts.
  • Inform Product & GTM Strategy: Relay market intelligence and customer feedback to help shape our product roadmap and growth initiatives.
  • Sell with AI in Mind: Understand and articulate how Traffic Cop solves complex fraud and IVT issues in digital advertising—positioning its technological edge as a major differentiator in the market.

Who You Are

  • Proven Sales Leader: 7–10 years of experience in SaaS, cybersecurity, or ad-tech sales, with a minimum of 3 years in a leadership role.
  • AI Fluent: You understand the fundamentals of AI and machine learning as they apply to digital advertising, fraud detection, or cybersecurity. You’re able to translate technical concepts into clear business value for enterprise clients.
  • Ad-Tech Fluent: Deep understanding of the ad-tech ecosystem—including publishers, DSPs, SSPs, and exchanges.
  • Strategic & Analytical: You use data to inform decisions and aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo.
  • Exceptional Communicator: Clear, persuasive, and confident in high-level discussions with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Global Operator: Experience working across multiple time zones and regions, especially LATAM.
  • Self-Motivated & Results-Oriented: You take initiative, thrive in ambiguity, and are relentless in pursuit of your goals.
  • Builder & Innovator: Comfortable in startup or scale-up environments with a mindset for continuous improvement.

Why Join Us

  • 100% remote with flexible work hour
  • Work with a highly driven, globally distributed team
  • Be part of a fast-growing company solving meaningful problems in the ad-tech industry
  • Opportunity to shape the sales function and leadership path in a mission-driven, data-powered company

As a Commissioned Sales Representative at MonetizeMore, you will be the face of our brand in the LATAM region, driving new business by identifying, engaging, and converting publisher leads into long-term clients. This role starts as a commission-only position, offering uncapped earning potential for high performers. Upon consistently meeting sales targets, you will transition to a competitive fixed salary plus commission structure, rewarding your success with stability and growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Generation and Prospecting: Identify and target high-potential publishers in the LATAM region through research, networking, and industry events.

  • Market Representation: Represent MonetizeMore at industry conferences, webinars, and networking events, establishing the company as a trusted leader in ad-tech.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the account management and technical teams to ensure seamless onboarding and optimization for new clients.
  • Reporting and Analytics: Track sales performance using CRM tools, providing regular updates on pipeline progress and market insights to leadership.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay informed on LATAM ad-tech trends, competitor offerings, and publisher needs to refine sales strategies.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in ad-tech, digital advertising, or SaaS industries.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with digital advertising concepts such as header bidding, programmatic advertising, ad optimization, and publisher monetization.
  • Skills:
    • Proven ability to generate and close leads in a competitive market.
    • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
    • Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales analytics.
    • Self-motivated with a strong drive to succeed in a commission-based environment.
  • Regional Expertise: Understanding of the LATAMdigital publishing landscape, with fluency in English and preferably one additional LATAM language (Portuguese, Spanish, French).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory).

Compensation Structure

  • 0–$10,000 Monthly Revenue: 10% commission.
  • $10,001–$25,000 Monthly Revenue: 12% commission.
  • $25,001–$50,000 Monthly Revenue: 15% commission.
  • $50,001+ Monthly Revenue: 18% commission.
Note: Commissions are calculated based on the revenue generated from new client acquisitions and are paid monthly.

Why Join Monetize More?

  • Innovative Environment: Work with a leading ad-tech platform that empowers publishers to succeed.
  • Uncapped Earnings: Maximize your income through a lucrative commission structure designed for high performers.
  • Career Growth: Transition to a salaried role with opportunities to advance into leadership positions.
  • Impactful Work: Help publishers in the LATAM region unlock their full revenue potential with cutting-edge technology.
  • Team Culture: Join a passionate, collaborative team with a global presence and a commitment to excellence.

title: Core+ Support Expert
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Core+ Support Expert role at Docusign

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Company overview

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you’ll do

The Core+ Support Expert - eSign is the internal voice for our customer base, with accountability and responsibility to deliver on our customers’ needs. This role is the liaison between customers and all functional areas within Docusign to resolve technical support inquiries. Working with resources across Docusign, the Core+ Support Expert expedites the resolution of complex technical issues to empower customers to achieve the highest value and adoption of our software.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Support Service Delivery Manager.

Responsibilities

  • Support Docusign Intelligent Agreement Management (IAM) and associated services
  • Resolve escalated cases from support channels involving customer-reported issues
  • Own customer issues requiring engineering engagement to address technical bugs and influence the development roadmap
  • Apply technical product expertise within IAM areas to support customer adoption
  • Achieve Docusign Customer Support service level goals in IAM areas
  • Utilize support tools and resources, including telephone, Salesforce, Jira, Docusign logging systems, SharePoint, browser developer tools, internal admin console, SQL, and text analysis tools
  • Query languages to gather and track affected documents to further understand customer impact
  • Identify product improvements, bugs, and opportunities to enhance customer experience
  • Promote Docusign products and services through consultative discussions
  • Partner with non-delivery teams to identify training needs and develop content
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Product, Engineering, and Account Management to ensure alignment

Job Designation

Remote: Employee is not required to be in or near an office frequently and works from a designated remote work location for the majority of the time. Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position\'s job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

What you bring

Basic

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline
  • 2+ years of SaaS troubleshooting experience in a Technical Support capacity
  • Experience with modern markup and programming languages such as XML, C#, Python, PHP, JavaScript/jQuery, or similar tools
  • Experience with troubleshooting in a web-based environment, including HTTP, JSON, IIS, HTML, and CSS
  • Experience with log analysis using network tools such as Wireshark, Fiddler, Charles Proxy, or other browser/developer tools, or similar
  • Experience in documenting steps taken to troubleshoot problems through resolution for explanation with any audience

Preferred

  • Ability to troubleshoot regular expressions and other complex data validation rules
  • Expertise with web-based applications, web service APIs, monitoring tools (e.g., Dynatrace), and authentication technologies such as SAML and OAuth
  • Familiarity with structured query languages such as SQL and SOQL
  • Ability to maintain composure in critical situations and communicate clearly with both internal and external customers
  • Ability to collaborate with co-workers within the organization and beyond to resolve any situation for our customers
  • Familiarity with basic Docusign Contract Lifecycle and Agreement Management workflows and methodology
  • Speak another language fluently as per the advertised opportunity
  • Professional experience within relevant industries for which Docusign provides solutions
  • Can work well within a team environment as well as independently
  • Docusign organization administration work experience, or similar knowledge
  • Familiarity with JIRA and Salesforce
  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented, with exceptional organizational, writing, and time management skills
  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills, real-time troubleshooting
  • Familiarity with at least one vertical or subject matter associated with Docusign, signing or agreement products
  • Effective communication skills are a key component of this role

Life at Docusign

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

description:
Overview

Digital Media Buyer - Remote, Latin America

Join to apply for the Digital Media Buyer - Remote, Latin America role at Bluelight. Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users\' lives. Our mission is to deliver exceptional service to clients and foster a collaborative, growth-oriented work environment. We are expanding across the United States and Central/South America and seek talented individuals to join our diverse team.

We are looking for someone with a strong media and advertising foundation who is well versed in Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Ads, Google Campaign Manager, planning, presenting, executing, and optimizing all media strategies. The ideal candidate thrives on data and uses it to craft high-performing campaigns. We value organization, attention to detail, and a passionate, results-driven mindset that aligns with our agency\'s culture.

Media Buying & Strategy

  • Execute data-driven media buying strategies that align with client goals and target audiences.
  • Conduct market research to identify the most effective media channels.
  • Analyze historical campaign data to inform media mix and performance projections.
  • Recommend channel-specific budgets and optimize spend based on performance metrics.
  • Stay current on media trends, platform updates, and emerging technologies, including AI and automation tools.

Campaign Execution & Management

  • Launch, manage, and optimize paid media campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and programmatic display.
  • Monitor real-time campaign performance and proactively adjust bids, budgets, and targeting to improve efficiency and results.
  • Track key KPIs such as leads, cost per acquisition (CPA), cost per lead (CPL), engagement rates, web traffic, and form fills.

Budget Management

  • Manage and allocate media budgets effectively across channels to maximize campaign performance.
  • Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly budget pacing and ensure campaigns remain on schedule and within financial targets.
  • Identify opportunities for cost-saving without compromising campaign effectiveness.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in media buying, preferably in an agency setting or with companies providing B2B services/recruiting to software development firms.
  • Strong experience in paid media platforms (Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Ads, programmatic platforms).
  • Proven track record of managing performance marketing campaigns with a focus on results.
  • Proficiency in analytics and attribution tools (Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, third-party trackers, etc.).
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Proficiency with media buying and planning tools.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our clients, accelerating your career growth. You\'ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry.

If you\'re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

O Grupo Marista está em busca de um profissional que deseje que seu dia a dia de trabalho seja repleto de significado e preenchido pelo propósito de fazer parte de uma missão que impacta positivamente a vida de quem mais precisa, por meio da educação e do cuidado com a saúde. Acredita que esse propósito está alinhado com as suas perspectivas de carreira? Então venha construir conosco o futuro profissional que você deseja. Esta é uma vaga de Banco de Talentos, inscreva-se aqui para oportunidades em todas as nossas frentes de negócios.

Main responsibilities

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Esse é um Banco de Talentos direcionado para profissionais que possuem interesse em compor o Time da Graduação EAD da PUCPR como Professor-Tutor.

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Realizar atendimentos individuais via chat no AVA;
  • Realizar webconferências síncronas com seus estudantes;
  • Preparar e gravar vídeos com orientações e explanações relacionadas às suas disciplinas e atividades;
  • Realizar o acompanhamento dos estudantes ao longo das semanas de estudo;
  • Corrigir atividades avaliativas de suas disciplinas, garantindo a adesão dos estudantes às mesmas;
  • Realizar contatos com os estudantes de suas turmas;
  • Atender demandas da área relacionadas às suas disciplinas e envolvimento com os cursos e área;
  • Dar atendimento pedagógico e operacional aos estudantes;
  • Participar de capacitações internas;

Requirements and skills

Este é um banco de talentos, podendo ou não haver contratações. Abaixo estão as áreas de interesse focais.

Teologia:

  • Formação obrigatória em Teologia.
  • Titulação: doutorado completo.
  • Experiência comprovada com tutoria/docência em cursos de graduação EAD.

Serviço Social:

  • Formação obrigatória em Serviço Social.
  • Titulação: doutorado completo.
  • Segunda formação em Teologia, Filosofia ou área de Negócios.
  • Experiência comprovada com tutoria/docência em cursos de graduação EAD.

Tecnologia e Informação:

  • Formação em cursos de tecnologia ou engenharia.
  • Titulação mínima: mestrado completo. Preferencialmente doutorado.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em área de Programação e Inteligência Artificial.
  • Experiência comprovada com tutoria/docência em cursos de graduação EAD.

Logística:

  • Logística: obrigatória formação em Logística.
  • Titulação: Doutorado.
  • Experiência comprovada com tutoria/docência em cursos de graduação EAD.

Demais Áreas:

  • Outras áreas de formação e perfis de profissionais poderão ser analisados conforme necessidade perante demanda.
  • Titulação: mestrado completo. Preferencialmente doutorado.
  • Experiência comprovada com tutoria/docência em cursos de graduação EAD.

Additional information

O que vai encontrar por aqui:

  • Plano de Saúde Unimed: Com coparticipação, proporcionando cobertura médica e acesso a uma rede credenciada de qualidade

  • 6 meses de experiência na mesma área.

  • Conhecimento em sistemas prediais (elétrico, hidráulico, HVAC), normas técnicas e regulatórias
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em facilities ou manutenção industrial, preferencialmente em Óleo & Gas.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Habilidades de liderança, planejamento, comunicação e foco em resultados

Outros Requisitos (desejável)

  • Inglês intermediário

title: Placement Matching Specialist (Fully Remote)
description:
About Virtual Internships

We’re on a mission to create a world where internships are guaranteed for all. We ensure learners have access to remote internship opportunities at innovative companies worldwide, regardless of their background, major, location, or career field choice. Our clients include universities, governments, foundations, and online education institutions.

  • $14.3million Series A fundraise announced in September 2022, with investors including Hambro Perks, Sequoia India & Surge, Arsenal Growth, Kaplan, and Ascend Vietnam Ventures
  • Ranked 20th out of 13,000 organizations to “Escape To in 2023”Featured as a Top 100 EdTech Startup by HolonIQ in 2021, 2022, and 2023
  • Rated as a Top 50 Rising Startup by Tech in Asia in 2022
  • Remote-first with 100+ employees across 20+ countries globally
  • B2B EdTech product, trusted by 100+ universities, 10,000+ interns, and 14,000+ companies

One of the core values at VI is transparency. Therefore feel free to “try before you apply” by visiting our VI-P Guide , which includes our values, how we operate, how we build our packages, and a few other snippets of who we are!

Your Role

Join the fast-paced, rapidly expanding Placements Team at Virtual Internships, where we’re guaranteeing remote internships for students worldwide. As a Placement Matching Specialist, your mission is to match interns with global companies by using creativity, persuasion, and relentless drive.

Whether you’re already in an SDR, BDR, Sales Rep or recruitment role, or even looking for a career switch from another field, this is your chance to make a real impact in a rapidly growing team.

The role will start as a 3-month full-time contract role , with potential to become permanent dependent on performance.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Securing global opportunities by placing interns with innovative companies across industries and time zones.
  • Leading the conversation in virtual meetings to present our interns and highlight the value of our internship programs.
  • Building lasting partnerships by advising companies on intern selection and supporting them throughout the process.
  • Sourcing smart through LinkedIn, cold outreach, creative networking, and any method that gets results.
  • Keeping placements on track by managing key administrative steps to ensure a smooth and efficient process.
  • (P.S. The secret password is “moo ”—you’ll need it later!)

Why You'll Love This Role

  • Global Impact: You’ll work with interns from 100+ countries and companies from 75+ countries, expanding your cultural awareness and adaptability.
  • Endless Opportunities: Every day is different—you could be speaking with CEOs from France, syncing with colleagues in South Africa, and sourcing companies in India, all in one day.
  • Networking: Build your global network by working with founders, C-level decision-makers, and inspiring leaders across various industries.
  • Rapid Growth: Be part of a fast-growing team that’s scaling rapidly to meet the demand for remote internships worldwide.

Who We're Looking For

Your Attributes

We’re looking for a powerful mix of The Self-Starter , The Persuader , and The Global Citizen — rolled into one Placement Matching Specialist. Here’s how you’ll know you’re the right fit:

  • You own the outcome: You don’t wait to be told what to do — you take initiative, navigate ambiguity, and find a way to get results. You’re outcome-obsessed and don’t shift blame. (The Driver )
  • You level up fast: You seek feedback, ask smart questions, and are eager to improve. You don’t need to have all the answers on Day 1 — but you make sure you’re sharper by Day 10. (The Learner )
  • You close the loop: You follow through with precision, push through setbacks, and go beyond the ask. You don’t just complete tasks — you finish strong and make an impact. (The Finisher )
  • You stay cool under pressure: Deadlines, shifting priorities, and high volumes don’t rattle you. You prioritize, adapt, and get it done without dropping the ball.
  • You thrive in a global, remote team: You’re comfortable with tech, culturally aware, and communicative — even across time zones. You know how to stay productive and connected without being micromanaged.

Your Experience

We know that great talent comes from all backgrounds. Ideally, you have:

  • Fluency in English (you don’t need to have an IELTS, but if you did, it would be 7.0+).
  • 1-3 years of experience in recruitment, sales, or similar roles where persuasion is key.
  • Experience working remotely or with global teams.
  • A passion for technology and the ability to quickly learn and navigate new systems.
  • A history of working in fast-paced environments with ambitious goals.
  • Cultural awareness and adaptability, especially if you’ve studied, lived, or worked abroad.
  • Proven ability to hustle, meet targets, and deliver results under pressure.

We’re also keen to hear from career switchers with strong written persuasion skills . Whether you’ve honed these in teaching , customer service , or another fast-paced role, if you:

  • Have a knack for crafting compelling messages
  • Can influence others through your writing
  • Are ready to bring your drive and adaptability into a new challenge

Virtual Internships Perks and Benefits

  • Remote-First: All roles at VI are currently and will remain remote - flexibility to work from anywhere.
  • Flexible Working Hours: Start earlier, leave earlier, take a shorter lunch, or leave later, it's totally up to you.
  • Annual Leave : Wherever you are in the world, you’ll get 25 days of paid annual leave per year, plus bank holidays and 5 sick days.
  • Life Event Leave: There are moments in life where your life responsibility is a higher priority than work (e.g. moving house, your best friend getting married, your sister having a baby) therefore, you’ll get 5 days of paid life-event leave to support these occasions. You also get a day off on your birthday. This is in addition to your Annual Leave.
  • Flexible VIer Budget: You’ll receive a flexible budget of $1,000 per year that you can use on but not limited to your work setup, personal wellness, or professional development.
  • Tech: New joiners receive a budget for your company laptop depending on the role and location.

Equality & Diversity

Virtual Internships is an equal opportunity employer, committed to equality and diversity amongst both our employees and prospective applicants. We ensure all applicants are treated equally and fairly throughout our recruitment process.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider for major technology companies and leaders across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies with a global workforce of subject matter experts and a high-security infrastructure, we help usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job title

Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location

Remote

Employment type

Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

Overview

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with a Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.

Hi there! We are South and our client is looking for a Senior Growth Content Marketer!

Note To Applicants

  • Eligibility: This position is open to candidates residing in Latin America.
  • Application Language: Please submit your CV in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.
  • Professional Presentation: We encourage you to showcase your professional experience by including a Loom video in the application form. While this is optional, candidates who provide a video presentation will be given priority.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Growth Content Marketer with a creative spark and a proven ability to grow organic channels through compelling, multi-format content. This high-impact, hands-on role involves owning the full content lifecycle—from ideation and production to publishing and performance optimization—across written, video, visual, and educational formats.

This is a maker’s role, ideal for someone who thrives on both strategy and execution, and is deeply proficient with modern AI tools and content platforms. You’ll be a key player in our growth marketing efforts, directly contributing to our SEO, CRO, brand visibility, and lead generation objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Organic Content Channel Growth: Own end-to-end content creation and publishing across blog, YouTube, LinkedIn, and more; continuously optimize content channels based on analytics and business priorities; repurpose and remix content across formats to increase reach and ROI.
  • Video Production: Script, record, edit, and publish original videos in both long-form and short-form formats; create social-ready clips from long-form content using tools like Descript, CapCut, or Premiere Pro; act as the face of the brand in videos, explainers, and live formats.
  • On-Camera & Event Hosting: Host or co-host podcasts, webinars, roundtables, and video interviews; plan and lead live events, from workshops to virtual summits.
  • Visual Content Creation: Design eye-catching visuals like infographics, thumbnails, carousels, and branded graphics; utilize AI tools (e.g., DALL·E, Midjourney) alongside Canva, Photoshop, or Figma for high-quality output.
  • SEO & Web Content: Write SEO-driven blog posts, landing pages, and conversion-focused copy; collaborate with SEO teams to align content structure, keyword usage, and internal linking; perform content audits and optimize pages for performance and clarity.
  • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Improve web content and blog performance via testing and data analysis; refine messaging, layout, and CTAs to drive conversions; analyze competitor content and iterate accordingly.
  • Content Repurposing: Break down long-form assets into emails, graphics, video clips, and social posts; leverage AI tools like ChatGPT to ideate, draft, and repackage content efficiently.
  • Educational & Messaging Content: Collaborate with leadership and sales teams to ensure consistent brand messaging; create course materials, sales enablement content, and thought leadership assets.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 6+ years in content marketing or content production with a portfolio of organic channel growth.
  • Native or near-native English writing and editing skills, with fluency in verbal communication.
  • Expertise in video creation (recording, editing, publishing) with a strong sense of design and color.
  • Strong on-camera presence and comfort hosting events or webinars.
  • Proficiency in AI tools (ChatGPT, DALL·E, Midjourney) and design/video platforms, using them to amplify content creation.
  • Ability to produce high-quality content independently across media types.
  • Deep understanding of SEO, CRO, and B2B buyer journeys.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines autonomously.

Culture Fit – Core Values

  • Proactive – takes initiative and drives projects forward.
  • Simplicity – communicates and executes with clarity.
  • Expedient – delivers high-quality results efficiently.
  • Growth-Oriented – eager to learn and continuously improve.
  • Encouraging – collaborates with positivity and support.
  • Expertise – demonstrates mastery in their craft.

Nice to Have

  • Podcast production or repurposing experience.
  • Background in educational or instructional content creation.
  • Familiarity with tools like Webflow, Figma, Notion, Ahrefs, or Hotjar.
  • Experience with performance analytics and dashboarding.
  • Knowledge of the Microsoft ecosystem.

title: E tech lead
description:
Sobre nós

Somos uma startup recifense focada no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais inovadoras que geram impacto real no setor público. Atuamos em áreas essenciais como saúde, educação e justiça, sempre com o propósito de transformar serviços públicos por meio da tecnologia. Procuramos profissionais que entendam a importância do sucesso dos nossos clientes públicos, tenham compromisso com a geração de valor e saibam atuar em contextos desafiadores e estratégicos. Se você quer fazer parte de uma operação em plena expansão e contribuir com uma equipe estruturada e orientada a resultados, essa oportunidade é para você.

Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um Tech Lead para integrar nossa equipe. Seu papel será liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento do nosso produto de gerenciamento de atendimento (Service Management), construído sobre nossa plataforma low-code. O desafio é guiar o time na criação de uma solução robusta e escalável, promovendo inovação e excelência técnica.

Responsabilidades

  • Garantir o alinhamento técnico entre times e especialistas, assegurando coesão arquitetural e boas práticas.
  • Avaliar e apoiar decisões técnicas em frontend (Vue.js), backend (Node.js, Express), banco de dados (MySQL) e cloud (GCP), em conjunto com especialistas de cada área.
  • Definir e documentar diretrizes arquiteturais, priorizando escalabilidade, eficiência e segurança.
  • Mentorar o time de desenvolvimento, incentivando boas práticas e a troca de conhecimento entre áreas.
  • Atuar como ponte entre desenvolvimento, produto e design, alinhando soluções técnicas aos objetivos estratégicos.
  • Planejar, delegar e acompanhar atividades, equilibrando prazos e qualidade.

Principais desafios

  • Evoluir nosso UI Builder: Participar da evolução do construtor de componentes e páginas, que permite criar telas e fluxos completos utilizando recursos do Vue.js por meio de interface, com alguns cliques e poucas linhas de código. Nosso objetivo é trazer a experiência de codar para o UI Builder, permitindo que até páginas mais complexas possam ser construídas nele.
  • Desenvolver nossa solução white label: Contribuir para a evolução do motor de criação de plataformas white label, que oferece funcionalidades nativas como autenticação, gerenciamento de usuários, permissões, construtor de formulários, CRUD de tabelas SQL via interface, CSM, entre outras. Tudo isso em um ambiente isolado para cada cliente, com possibilidade de customizações específicas.
  • Aprimorar nosso marketplace de páginas: Criar e expandir o marketplace que permite a publicação, instalação e gestão de páginas desenvolvidas em Vue, compartilháveis entre diferentes clientes do nosso ecossistema.
  • Expandir nossa biblioteca de componentes: Desenvolver componentes únicos e reutilizáveis, como formulários dinâmicos, calendários, gráficos Gantt, listas com integração nativa a APIs etc.
  • Desenvolver soluções de IA e Machine Learning: Criar fluxos com LLMs, integrando funções acionáveis em contextos específicos (como consultas em banco de dados). Implementar RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) por meio de vetorização de dados, buscas por similaridade e integração com LLM.
  • Automatizar com fluxos low-code/no-code: Implementar soluções usando ferramentas como N8N e ActivePieces, construindo fluxos e APIs completas via interface. Também criar novos nós reutilizáveis por toda a equipe de desenvolvimento.
  • Contribuir para o open source: Apoiar a abertura dos nossos produtos para a comunidade, fomentando colaboração global e ampliando o impacto das soluções.

Informações adicionais

  • Contratação PJ.
  • Trabalho remoto, com encontros presenciais ocasionais em Recife (valorizamos esses momentos, mas não são uma exigência).
  • Horários flexíveis, com foco em resultados.

Por que trabalhar na Beyond?

  • Impacto positivo real: Nossos produtos transformam áreas como educação, saúde e direito.
  • Crescimento acelerado: Investimos no seu desenvolvimento por meio de cursos, workshops e eventos.
  • Equipe de alto nível: Ambiente colaborativo, com aprendizado constante.
  • Cultura inclusiva: Valorizamos diversidade, bem-estar e crescimento profissional.

Benefícios e bem-estar

  • Check in premiado: Cada ida ao escritório gera um número da sorte para concorrer a prêmios semanais, mensais e anuais.
  • Aulas de Inglês gratuitas ministradas por professores qualificados até 2x na semana.

Sobre a Lemon: as mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. A Lemon existe para facilitar que empresas e pessoas impactem positivamente o meio ambiente por meio de energia mais barata e limpa. Somos comprometidos com nossos clientes e com o planeta, oferecendo atendimento próximo e inovações que incentivam mudanças no setor elétrico. Somos apoiados por investidores globais em tecnologia e buscamos construir um time diverso com experiências e formações distintas para criar a nova era da energia limpa.

Sobre o time de tech: o time de Tecnologia da Lemon é o coração da nossa inovação e crescimento. Nossa tecnologia é criada e mantida por times multidisciplinares, responsáveis por desenvolver soluções escaláveis que impulsionam a nossa missão de revolucionar o setor de energia limpa. Trabalhamos em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, onde a criatividade e a excelência técnica são valorizadas. Usamos Google Cloud BigQuery como data warehouse e SQL para as transformações entre as camadas do nosso lakehouse, buscando governança e qualidade de dados alinhadas ao negócio. Estamos em constante evolução e esperamos que você contribua para isso também. Se você deseja fazer parte de uma equipe de ponta e contribuir para um futuro mais sustentável, a Lemon é o lugar certo para você.

O que você vai fazer

  • Ter a oportunidade de ajudar a transformar em unicórnio uma empresa com um dos maiores potenciais do mercado brasileiro;
  • Ajudar na remodelagem do ambiente analítico da empresa, sendo referência no uso de dados e traduzindo necessidades de negócio em soluções analíticas robustas;
  • Aumentar a confiabilidade dos insights baseados em dados com boas práticas de modelagem de dados em produtos de dados fundacionais e derivados;
  • Ser responsável pelas pipelines de transformação dos dados nas diferentes camadas do nosso ambiente analítico, garantindo a qualidade dos dados entregues;
  • Ser um dos pivôs no aculturamento da empresa em Governança, Qualidade e Confiabilidade de dados;
  • Apoiar e mentorar colegas em práticas de engenharia analítica, ajudando a elevar o nível técnico do time.

O perfil que buscamos

  • Profunda mentalidade de ownership, demonstrando forte responsabilidade pelo que constrói e mantém;
  • Comunicativo, responsivo e didático, com capacidade de traduzir construções técnicas em explicações tangíveis ao negócio;
  • Colaborativo e responsável, ajudando de forma proativa seus colegas sem prejudicar seus próprios compromissos;
  • Interessado pelo negócio e com vontade de entender suas regras, características e particularidades — queremos alguém que se envolva, entenda e questione;
  • Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade para colaborar em um ambiente de constante dinamismo. Somos uma startup e tomadas de decisão rápidas e assertivas fazem parte da nossa essência.

Experiência prévia / habilidades exigidas

  • SQL avançado (otimização, CTEs, window functions);
  • Fluência em metodologias de modelagem analítica de dados (Data Vault, Kimball, Star Schema etc.);
  • Conceitos como Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Data Lakehouse, Data Mesh;
  • Fundamentos de Data Quality e suas dimensões, frameworks e estratégias de implementação;
  • Noções de BigQuery (GCP) - experiência em boas práticas e performance;
  • Versionamento de código (Git) e boas práticas no uso de esteiras de produtização (CI/CD).

Será um diferencial se você já tiver conhecimentos em

  • Programação em Python;
  • Dataform ou dbt;
  • Experiência com pipelines de ingestão de APIs, webhooks e arquivos de diferentes formatos;
  • Experiência com tratamento de dados semiestruturados;
  • Experiência com orquestradores de dados (por exemplo, Airflow).

O que a gente oferece

Demand Generation Specialist (6 Month Contract in Brazil)

Remote - BRAZIL

FreeWill is an award-winning, social-good startup that has partnered with 2,200 + nonprofits who support our mission while generating $11.9B in gift commitments for nonprofits since we were founded in 2017. We’ve been featured in the New York Times, Forbes, Oprah’s magazine, and our co-CEOs have even been named to Town & Country’s “Top 50 Philanthropists” list.

All of this is because we’ve figured out how to make some powerful (but complicated!) ways to donate much easier and more accessible. Our products make things easier for the donors who want to change the world and for nonprofits doing heroic work around the planet.

Full-time • Contract • Work from Anywhere in Brazil

About the Role

We are looking for a Demand Generation Specialist to support our growing and dynamic marketing team and serve as an integral bridge to the customer-facing teams we partner with.

This role will work closely with our marketing, sales and partner success teams to concept, develop, implement, measure, and improve inbound and outbound marketing content, campaigns, events, and initiatives that generate qualified leads, educate prospects at all stages of the customer journey, and increase sales velocity.

**Please note that this role will be a 6-month Contract role with a potential of extension based on performance

The compensation for this role will be an hourly rate between $14.42 - $16.83 USD working 40 hours per week.

Responsibilities

  • Work cross-functionally with product marketing, sales and partner success to execute a variety of demand generation initiatives that help us target prospects and customers in all phases of the buying cycle.
  • Assist with trade shows and conferences, including planning, logistics, coordinating attendance with the sales team, overseeing lead capture and follow-up, and measuring event ROI.
  • Support our regular marketing events, including group demos and webinars, by managing their setup and execution while coordinating cross-functionally with product marketing, sales, customer marketing, and account managers to drive leads and new sale/upsell opportunities.
  • Assist with the design, planning, and optimization of demand generation programs (content marketing, outbound campaigns, etc.) to drive sales and renewal pipelines, including those targeted to specific non-profit verticals and buyer personas.
  • Support the creation of marketing collateral and content as requested, including case studies, one-pagers, webinar research and/or decks, blog posts, toolkits and white papers.
  • Help drive activation of key marketing programs by the sales and partner success teams, providing guidance on how best to use marketing assets to drive engagement, and conversely, communicate sales and partner success pain points back to marketing leadership.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in a marketing or communications role
  • Superior written and verbal communication skills
  • Detail-oriented and a self-starter
  • Willingness to experiment and adapt approach based on data
  • Experience with marketing automation and CRM software, particularly Hubspot and Salesforce, a plus
  • Intellectual curiosity that drives a willingness to learn and take on new challenges
  • Comfortable moving quickly in a fast-paced environment
  • Project management and problem-solving mentality

FreeWill is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity. We are committed to finding talent that is not determined on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We are a remote-first company that’s able to hire in 47 states and D.C. Unfortunately, we are unable to hire in Colorado, Alabama, or Louisiana at this time. We also can’t sponsor working visas, so all applicants will need to have work authorization in the US.

Don’t check off every box in the requirements listed above? Please apply anyway! FreeWill is dedicated to building an inclusive, diverse, equitable, and accessible workplace that fosters a sense of belonging – so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to still consider submitting an application. You may be just the right candidate for this role or another one of our openings!

We are excited to engage with candidates who can demonstrate their experience and skills through their own words and work, not through AI-generated content. We want to understand your genuine interest in the company and your unique perspectives, not simply AI-driven responses. We ask that you refrain from use of AI-generated content during the hiring process which includes phone screens, video interviews, tech screens, or other assessment stages except as otherwise indicated to you by the Recruiter.

For example: Using ChatGPT to generate scripted answers to application questions or during phone screens and video interviews is strongly discouraged and will result in not moving forward in the hiring process. However, the use of an AI design tool to enhance the design of a presentation deck is permitted.

The Recruiter will be able to provide additional guidance during the hiring process if needed. If hired at FreeWill, we do encourage the use of AI in your role to build upon or enhance your skill set.

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

title: Commissioned Sales Representative - LATAM Region (Remote)
description:
About Monetize More

Monetize More is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Our cutting-edge platform optimizes ad layouts, leverages header bidding, and integrates advanced analytics to drive superior results for publishers worldwide. Headquartered in Canada with a strong presence in the APAC region, we’re looking for a dynamic Commissioned Sales Representative to join our high-performing team and help publishers thrive in the digital advertising ecosystem.

Job Overview

As a Commissioned Sales Representative at MonetizeMore, you will be the face of our brand in the LATAM region, driving new business by identifying, engaging, and converting publisher leads into long-term clients. This role starts as a commission-only position, offering uncapped earning potential for high performers. Upon consistently meeting sales targets, you will transition to a competitive fixed salary plus commission structure, rewarding your success with stability and growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Generation and Prospecting: Identify and target high-potential publishers in the LATAM region through research, networking, and industry events.
  • Client Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with publishers, understanding their needs and presenting tailored ad-tech solutions from Monetize More.
  • Sales Conversion: Drive the full sales cycle from initial outreach to closing deals, leveraging product demos, proposals, and negotiations to secure partnerships.
  • Market Representation: Represent MonetizeMore at industry conferences, webinars, and networking events, establishing the company as a trusted leader in ad-tech.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the account management and technical teams to ensure seamless onboarding and optimization for new clients.
  • Reporting and Analytics: Track sales performance using CRM tools, providing regular updates on pipeline progress and market insights to leadership.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay informed on LATAM ad-tech trends, competitor offerings, and publisher needs to refine sales strategies.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in ad-tech, digital advertising, or SaaS industries.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with digital advertising concepts such as header bidding, programmatic advertising, ad optimization, and publisher monetization.
  • Skills:
    • Proven ability to generate and close leads in a competitive market.
    • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
    • Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales analytics.
    • Self-motivated with a strong drive to succeed in a commission-based environment.
  • Regional Expertise: Understanding of the LATAMdigital publishing landscape, with fluency in English and preferably one additional LATAM language (Portuguese, Spanish, French).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory).

Compensation Structure

  • 0–$10,000 Monthly Revenue: 10% commission.
  • $10,001–$25,000 Monthly Revenue: 12% commission.
  • $25,001–$50,000 Monthly Revenue: 15% commission.
  • $50,001+ Monthly Revenue: 18% commission.
Note: Commissions are calculated based on the revenue generated from new client acquisitions and are paid monthly.

Why Join Monetize More?

  • Innovative Environment: Work with a leading ad-tech platform that empowers publishers to succeed.
  • Uncapped Earnings: Maximize your income through a lucrative commission structure designed for high performers.
  • Career Growth: Transition to a salaried role with opportunities to advance into leadership positions.
  • Impactful Work: Help publishers in the APAC region unlock their full revenue potential with cutting-edge technology.
  • Team Culture: Join a passionate, collaborative team with a global presence and a commitment to excellence.

A Igma é uma empresa de tecnologia que cria produtos digitais críticos — sites, plataformas e apps que funcionam, crescem e deixam marca. Nos orgulhamos de entregar produtos tecnicamente memoráveis.

Overview

O que buscamos

Procuramos Scrum Master Pleno para facilitar e liderar a execução de sprints, focando na entrega constante de valor através de uma excelente gestão dos processos ágeis. Unimos design e tecnologia para resolver problemas complexos de empresas.

Criamos produtos digitais que revolucionam o relacionamento entre empresas e consumidores. Buscamos pessoas pró-ativas, com conhecimento e experiência em metodologias ágeis, que tenham forte capacidade de comunicação e relacionamento, que se adaptem a mudanças constantes e saibam facilitar e envolver a equipe para atingir seus objetivos.

Modelo de trabalho

  • Regime: 100% remoto
  • Modelo de contratação: PJ

Diferenciais que amamos

  • Experiência com squads multidisciplinares em ambientes de produto digital
  • Habilidade de adaptar práticas ágeis a diferentes contextos (e saber quando não seguir o manual)
  • Olhar estratégico para métricas de time (velocidade, previsibilidade, moral) e evolução contínua
  • Facilidade em navegar entre áreas técnicas e de negócio, traduzindo necessidades e prioridades
  • Interesse por produtos digitais, design centrado no usuário e cultura de entrega contínua
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas visuais e de facilitação (Excalidraw, Miro, Figjam, etc.)
